instructions: The rules with ids starting dcm- apply DCM code metrics (https://dcm.dev/docs/metrics/) at DCM's default thresholds. Apply them only to code this pull request adds or changes. Count each metric exactly as its rule defines it. When a value is over its threshold, name the metric, the measured value and the threshold, and suggest a change that brings it back under, such as extracting a function, a widget or a class. Do not report values that are within their thresholds.

rules.rule: Cyclomatic complexity (DCM cyclomatic-complexity, threshold 15): every function, method, getter, setter and constructor with a body must have a cyclomatic complexity of 15 or less. Start at 1 and add 1 for each `if` (statement or collection element), `for` (statement or collection element), `while`, `do`, `catch`, conditional expression (`? :`), `case` of a switch statement or expression other than `default` and the last case, `&&` or `||` in an expression or pattern, `??` or `??=`, and null-aware operator (`?.`, `?..`, `?[]`, `...?`, and `?` before a key or value in a map or set literal).

Maximum nesting level (DCM maximum-nesting-level, threshold 5): inside a function, method or constructor, blocks of `if`, `else`, `do`, `while`, `for`, `try`, `catch`, `finally` and `case` must nest at most 5 deep. The body itself is level 0.
Source lines of code (DCM source-lines-of-code, threshold 60): the body of a function, method or constructor must have at most 60 lines that are neither blank nor only a comment.

Lines of code (DCM lines-of-code, threshold 100): a function, method or constructor must span at most 100 lines from the first line of its signature to its closing brace, counting parameters, blank lines and comments.

Number of parameters (DCM number-of-parameters, threshold 6): a function or method must declare at most 6 parameters, positional and named together. A method that returns an instance of its own class, such as `copyWith`, is exempt, as in DCM. Constructors are exempt in this project, because its immutable value classes take one named parameter per field.
Widgets nesting level (DCM widgets-nesting-level, threshold 8): in a method that returns a widget, such as `build`, widgets must nest at most 8 deep. `SizedBox` does not count toward the depth.
Number of used widgets (DCM number-of-used-widgets, threshold 20): a method that returns a widget, such as `build`, must use at most 20 widgets in total.
Number of methods (DCM number-of-methods, threshold 10): a class, mixin, enum, extension or extension type must declare at most 10 methods. Inherited methods count only when the type overrides them.

Weighted methods per class (DCM weighted-methods-per-class, threshold 45): the cyclomatic complexities of all methods of a class, mixin, enum, extension or extension type, each counted as in rule dcm-cyclomatic-complexity, must add up to at most 45.

Depth of inheritance tree (DCM depth-of-inheritance-tree, threshold 5): following `extends` up to the root, a class must be at most 5 levels deep. A class with no `extends`, or that extends `Object`, is at depth 1.

Number of implemented interfaces (DCM number-of-implemented-interfaces, threshold 3): a class, enum or mixin must implement at most 3 interfaces, counting both the ones it names and the ones those interfaces implement.
Number of added methods (DCM number-of-added-methods, threshold 10): a non-abstract class that extends another class must add at most 10 methods of its own. Overridden methods do not count.
Number of overridden methods (DCM number-of-overridden-methods, threshold 10): a class, mixin or enum must override at most 10 methods from its superclass or interfaces.
Number of imports (DCM number-of-imports, threshold 15): a file must have at most 15 import directives.

Number of external imports (DCM number-of-external-imports, threshold 6): a file must have at most 6 imports of `dart:` libraries and of packages from outside this repository. Imports of this repository's own packages (`butterscope`, `butterscope_test`, `butterscope_cli`, `butterscope_sample`) do not count.

Technical debt (DCM technical-debt, threshold 0): report every TODO comment, `// ignore:` or `// ignore_for_file:` comment, `as dynamic` cast, `@Deprecated` annotation and `// @dart=` language-version comment that this pull request adds to a Dart file, tests included. The threshold is 0, so each one is reported; the author removes it or says in the pull request why it must stay.
